messages:
Maya: Heads up — saw tenant T-42 hit sustained saturations on primary-model-g and we spilled to a fallback manually. Thinking we need an autoswitch that probes compatible variants instead of hard swap.
Alex: +1. What's the visible failure mode? queue blowup or slot exhaustion?
Jordan: Slot exhaustion. Autoscaler couldn't add capacity fast enough, requests piled and we started dropping for that tenant.
Maya: ops-bot posted: "ops-bot: [ALERT] model primary-model-g saturated in us-west-2 for tenant T-42, 95% slot usage". We manually routed them to primary-model-g-quant (slower but available).
Lee: Manual ops is risky. We should have a graceful spill: probe a cheaper variant first with a tiny sample, then divert if latency/regression is fine.
Sam: Remember tiering. T-42 is platinum — keep quality loss minimal. Auto-spill for platinum must be conservative.
Priya: UX: console needs per-tenant toggle "Enable autoswitch spillover" with dry-run and per-variant sampling rate. Also a live Sankey for traffic.
Alex: Telemetry proposal: per-tenant metrics fallback_rate, probe_success_rate, p95_hand_off_latency, variant_quality_delta. Also log routing_decision with tenant_id, tier, region, available_slots.
Jordan: API idea: route headers like X-Client-Priority: platinum, X-Variant-Policy: prefer="fp16,8bit" and a server-side policy block: 
{
  "fallback_policy": {
    "type": "probe_then_spill",
    "probe_fraction": 0.02,
    "probe_variants": ["primary-model-g-quant","primary-model-g-8bit"],
    "success_threshold": 0.8
  }
}

Lee: +1. Defaults must respect tier/region. Suggested thresholds: platinum=0.95, gold=0.85, free=0.6.
Maya: Safeguards: no probes during emergency mode; add cooldown per-tenant/variant to avoid churn.
Sam: Quota interaction: spilled traffic can consume fallback capacity and hurt others. Mark spilled tokens as spill_usage and consider burst credits or throttling.
Priya: Console timeline: show events probe_start, probe_result, spill_start, spill_end, rollback. Each links to traces and sample responses.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: "rolling experiment 10% of plat tenants using probe_then_spill policy in us-west-2" :eyes:
Alex: Rollout plan: 1) feature-flagged dry-run with telemetry only. 2) 1% sample with probe-only logs. 3) 10% with actual spill and strict thresholds/cooldowns. 4) broader.
Jordan: Important: deterministic behavior for retries. If a probe succeeds we should stick to that variant for the same top-level request to avoid inconsistent outputs.
Lee: Implement sticky mapping per request-id inside a spill_window.
Sam: Cross-region: don't spill to another region unless tenant allows. Policy flag route_fallback_regions: [same, nearby] and respect data residency.
Priya: Console card: per-tenant fallback policy preview with expected quality delta, estimated cost delta, and toggle for cross-region spill.
Maya: Alerts: fallback_rate > 0.5% for platinum => page ops. quality_delta breach => auto-rollback or disable autoswitch for affected tenant.
Alex: Integrate Redwood Optimize: run small eval set during probe to estimate quality_delta; abort if hallucination or quality drops.
Jordan: Router needs a probe sampler per tenant, async aggregator for outcomes, and a fast decision path for low-latency. Maybe probe inline for first 1-2 tokens?
Lee: For perf, mirror the prompt in a low-priority capped probe and use probe result within 200ms. If no probe, follow SLA (queue or fallback).
Sam: Billing: spilled tokens charged at variant rate and tagged as spill_cost in billing records.
Priya: UI note: show console banner during rollout: "Autoswitching is in dry-run for your org — metrics under Routing -> Autoswitch" and opt-in button.
Maya: Action items: Alex: config schema + headers, Jordan: router probe worker + sticky-id, Lee: console mockups, Priya: thresholds + alerts, Sam: billing/spill accounting, Infra: sampling canary via deploy-bot.
Maya: Quick poll: default probe_fraction? global 0.1% then ramp per-tenant when saturation detected; per-tenant cap 2% for high tiers.
Alex: Agrees with 0.1% start, per-tenant up to 2% during saturation.
Jordan: I'll prototype probe_then_spill branch and wire a debug endpoint to emit decision logs for dry-run.
Priya: Adding console toggles and metric widgets to mock.
Lee: Follow-up next week after prototype: tagging @Alex @Jordan @Priya @Sam.
Maya: Nice work team. :thumbsup:
